_comment: The claim ledger, as data. 10-launch-brief.md is the human-readable version;
this is what claim-lint.py enforces. Keep the two in step.
red    — must never appear in published copy. Hard fail.
amber  — may appear only with a qualifier nearby. Fail if the qualifier is missing.
figures— canonical values. Fail if the copy states a different number for the same fact.
'exempt' lists files where a pattern is allowed because the file is *about* the
prohibition (the brief's own red list, this file, the linter itself).

red.why: Withdrawn by findings-15. The signal was an M6.0 in Mindanao 28 min before the collapse.
results-07 withdrawn. No recall figure survives the audit.
results-07 withdrawn. No false-alarm rate survives the audit.
Both validated events are European. Himalayan near-field records are not on open FDSN.
No node is on a mountain. Production holds glacier-node-001..004 from one bench day.
ADR-005 phases 3 and 4 — not built. (Optim's camera FIRMWARE business does ONVIF; that is not Aether managing ONVIF devices.)
Firmware has never been compiled with classify_event() implemented. Design target only.

amber.why: Target deep-sleep current from node_config.h, never measured on built firmware.
What denser geometry would give, not what has been measured.
